verdict.rationale: Mixpanel has a Flows capability. The MCP docs list "flows" alongside funnels and retention as queryable reports, and a community user praises the Flow feature as getting "to the heart of most of the information you need on user flows," though other users found its hover-based UI hard to dig into. First-party evidence is only a passing mention, and nothing shows paths anchored before or after a chosen key event. Missing for 10: dedicated Flows report documentation, explicit before/after-event path exploration, recent hands-on corroboration of path analysis depth.
